name: Tony Duncan
headline: Professional Services & SaaS Delivery Leader | AI Transformation Leader | Contact Center Technology Expert | P&L Ownership | AI-Enabled Service Transformation
about:
As a Senior Director of Professional Services with nearly three decades in the contact center industry, I lead high-performing teams to deliver complex, enterprise-scale SaaS implementations that drive measurable business value. I hold full P&L accountability for a regional portfolio—overseeing services revenue forecasting, margin optimization, and executive performance reporting.

At Five9, I’m spearheading the AI transformation of our Professional Services organization—integrating artificial intelligence into project delivery, customer management, and internal operations to enhance efficiency, predictability, and client outcomes.

My leadership philosophy is grounded in three pillars: delivery excellence, customer success, and team growth. I build and empower teams that translate complex technology into clear business impact, fostering a culture where innovation and accountability thrive. Partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product, I align cross-functional strategies that strengthen long-term client relationships and elevate the overall delivery experience.

Core Strengths:
 • Executive Leadership & Business Management: Strategic planning, P&L ownership, margin improvement, and operational efficiency
 • Program & Portfolio Delivery: Governance, risk management, scalable methodologies, and delivery models
 • Team Development: Coaching senior Program Managers, capacity planning, and organizational growth
 • Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Strategic account planning, NPS improvement, and executive advisory
 • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Driving alignment across Sales, CS, Engineering, and Product
 • AI-Driven Transformation: Embedding AI in delivery and operations to scale performance and readiness for next-generation technology

Passionate about transforming Professional Services through data-driven insight and AI-enabled strategy, I’m committed to redefining how service organizations deliver value, scale operations, and elevate customer experience.

experiences.description:
In this role, I am responsible for consultative performance in all areas related to Five9’s solutions provisioning, implementation, and deployment of technical and business solutions to clients. 

*  Lead and manage all aspects of Five9’s implementation of On Demand Call Center software based on best practices and customer requirements
*  Lead and manage the discovery, design, configuration and deployments
*  Enable customers to attain optimal results from Five9 products by managing their expectations and satisfaction as a top priority
Coached the U10 team while coaching in and coordinating all aspects of the National Youth Academy.

Worked in the Professional Services group within the Managed Service division. Focus is working with Contact Center Technologies such as Genesys ACD, GVP IVR, ServiceNow ITSM, Speech Recognition, Speech Analytics, Chat, Email and Virtual Hold. Program Management role includes Program, Project and operational team management of the Genesys platform.  Work directly with customers directing the implementation from discovery to post launch support as well as managing the customer experience through trouble and change management.  Lead a team of platform managers in the implementation and maintenance of the contact center platforms.  This includes project management of data center implementations including infrastructure, virtual machine and database builds.

Current role leads a dynamic team whose role is to interface with all business partners to do requirements, business and systems analysis and project management.  We interface directly with the IT organizations at the executive level and directly with developers to ensure the solution being developed meets the needs of the business.  My team project manages the effort and performs end user testing before launch.  We perform these functions primarily on contact center technologies such as IVR, ACD, email management, quality recording, text to speech and Virtual Hold.

Implemented Virtual Hold in 3 contact centers where grade of service went from 68% to 85% in 1 month with no additional headcount. Project was completed ahead of schedule and under budget.

Redesigned the call routing infrastructure to allow for queuing in the Cloud. This design increased call capacity by 200%, increased ability to perform quality call recording from 25% to 100% of calls, allowed calls to be routed to first available agent regardless of physical location, and allowed for customized emergency messages based on caller location and menu choices selected by customer.

Automated outbound calls for trouble ticket status and payment issues resulting in a 10-fold increase in ability to provide information to customer. Automation allowed for system and/or process events to trigger outbound calls.

Employed IVR Intelligent call routing that allowed for customized service based on customer identification and tiered system of service. Implemented a multi-system approach of customer identification, which improved the accuracy of identification from 35% to 72%.
